- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 2025, especially after mid-2024 peaks; adjust downward bias for recent historical trends.
- Forecast tends to overshoot after sharp price spikes (e.g., 80+ → 85+), then corrects sharply; cap forecast at 5–10% above recent peak for 3–5 day horizon.
- Mean reversion is overestimated; model often assumes prices will return to 70–75 range too quickly; delay correction by 1–2 days or reduce magnitude.
- Forecast lags true price movements by 1–3 days; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead for short-term (1–7 day) horizons.
- For 30-day forecasts, model exhibits persistent downward bias; add 2–5% to forecast mean to align with historical 30d true mean (e.g., ~71.5–72.5).
- Avoid overreacting to single-day volatility; smooth 30d forecast by averaging 3–5 prior days if price volatility exceeds 3% from prior period.
